LESSON: RESOURCE MOBILISATION

Grade: SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade 10
Subject: COMMUNITY SERVICE LEARNING FOR LEARNERS WITH VISUAL IMPAIRMENT JUNE
Strand: Social Entrepreneurship
Topic 4.4: Resource Mobilisation
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 6

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Resource Mobilisation, part of Social Entrepreneurship in SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade 10 COMMUNITY SERVICE LEARNING FOR LEARNERS WITH VISUAL IMPAIRMENT JUNE.

Key inquiry question: How can you acquire resources for the establishment of a social enterprise?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Resource Mobilisation together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
Creativity and Imagination: Learners explore new ideas when discussing ways of acquiring other resources not locally

available.

Values:
● Respect: Learners appreciate diverse opinions as they brainstorm and identify resources needed for implementation

of a social enterprise plan.

● Unity: Learners collaborate with others to develop a budget for social enterprise.

47

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
Civic responsibility is enhanced as the learners map out the stakeholders needed to acquire the resource.

Suggested learning resources:

Braille reference materials, print reference materials with appropriate font and colour contrast, locally available

materials, print and braille learner’s books, braille and print writing materials.

Key skills:

• Analysing the concept of resource mobilisation for social enterprise.

• Analysing components of a social enterprise plan.

• Developing a low-cost budget for social enterprise development.

• Developing social enterprise ideas for the community.

• Developing a social enterprise plan for the opportunity identified.

48
